title: Chapter 106: The Sound Behind the Door
html:
Chen Ge’s hand froze. Most disturbing of all, the reflected door stood open at precisely the same angle as the real one. He removed the cloth, approached the cubicle, and watched the mirror as he pushed the door fully open.

The real cubicle was empty. Its reflection was not. The narrow space glowed red, as if blood seeped from the ceiling, walls, and floor. It belonged to another world.

He could not bring himself to enter. With one hand on the knob, he wondered whether to demolish the cubicle altogether. Ten seconds later, a strange sound reached him, at once distant and close—the drag of someone in soaked clothing crawling across a floor.

Where is that coming from?

The sound sharpened as it drew nearer. Chen Ge checked the corridor, then looked back at the mirror. It was coming from the reflected cubicle.

Something is coming.This was no time for curiosity. He slammed the door and jammed a mop beneath its handle, then faced the mirror. Something heavy dragged itself into the reflected cubicle. Red pooled beneath the door as whatever lay beyond seemed to search the room, filling the air with the smell of blood. Several seconds later, the sound retreated and the odor faded.

Chen Ge pressed his back to the wall, palms slick with sweat. Had he not awakened, the crawling thing might have escaped just as the mirror monster had.

Even beneath the black cloth, the blood-red door appears on schedule.He understood nothing about the world beyond it. For now, all he could do was leave it alone.

After splashing cold water on his face, Chen Ge returned to the staff break room and found Xiaoxiao gone again.

Did she wake me to warn me?He sat on the edge of the bed. Unable to sleep, he opened the black phone’s Daily Mission tab.

Easy Mission: A normal Haunted House experience should not leave visitors permanently traumatized. I hope you understand this simple principle. Inspect the Haunted House for hidden safety hazards and improve its security.

Normal Mission: One hand cannot clap. A good Haunted House needs a capable team. Recruit more talent; their help will prove invaluable when the need arises.

Nightmare Mission: Someone else has always lived in your room. Wouldn’t you like to meet them?

He recognized all three missions from the previous update.

The Easy and Normal missions are things that I should be doing at the current stage, more help around the place and improved security. However, in comparison, the reward of the Nightmare Mission is far more alluring.

Risk brought reward. More importantly, recruiting the Pen Spirit had given him one fortune-telling attempt per day. Using it to assess the Nightmare Mission seemed ideal.

The taped-together pen looked pitiful in his hand. When I get the chance, I should ask whether she wants a new one.

He placed a sheet of paper on the table and summoned the Pen Spirit. “Can I complete the black phone’s latest Nightmare Mission safely?”

He waited. The pen trembled but wrote nothing.

“Is that question too difficult?” The Pen Spirit was less omniscient than he had imagined; anything involving the black phone lay beyond her. As the damaged pen began to strain, he quickly changed course. “That one doesn’t count. Has someone else been living in this room?”

After a long pause, the pen wrote, “Yes.”

“Then, do you know what he looks like?”

The pen returned to normal without answering. Chen Ge did not blame her. Divination must have been exhausting; that was probably why she could attempt it only once a day.

So, there is another person living here. How have I not noticed all this time? Based on the mission introduction, the person is another friend from the other side.There were quite a few supernatural tenants living in Chen Ge’s Haunted House. He did not mind any more weird spirits as long as it did not actively harm his business like the mirror ghost.

After a moment’s hesitation, Chen Ge accepted the Nightmare Mission.

“Are you sure you wish to accept the Nightmare Mission? Unforeseen consequences may occur.”

“Yes.”

The screen flickered, and a new message appeared.

“It stays in the same room as you. After you fall asleep, it will appear.

“If it is kind, it will wash away the negative energy and keep the household safe and healthy.

“If it is malicious, when you are asleep, it will stand beside your bed, thinking about how to ruin you.

“This game is called ‘The Invisible Customer.’ At midnight, scatter soaked uncooked rice throughout the house, place a pair of worn slippers outside the door, and light a white candle on the bedroom floor. Arrange the bed to look as though someone is sleeping beneath the covers, then hide underneath it. For the mission to work, you must truly fall asleep. Catch a glimpse of the customer’s face to complete the mission.

“This will be your third Nightmare Mission. Completing it will randomly unlock a scenario’s Trial Mission.

“Warning: After you complete your third Nightmare Mission, future Daily Nightmare Missions will be randomized. Treat every opportunity with care!”

Chen Ge quickly memorized the instructions.

Why must I fall asleep for the mission? How will I take a look at the person’s face if I’m asleep? In my dreams?Chen Ge did not understand the meaning of this mission, but since he had accepted it, he could only follow the instructions.

He pulled on his jacket and once again visited the park canteen after hours to “borrow” half a bowl of rice.

The Haunted House is enormous. Covering every floor would waste too much rice.He soaked the grains in cold water and scattered them through several first-floor rooms. Then he placed worn slippers at the corridor entrance and lit a white candle beside his bed.
